scripts.build: strapi-plugin build && node scripts/stamp-ee-spdx.mjs && node scripts/check-ee-bundled.mjs
scripts.test:unit:form-entitlements: tsc server/src/utils/__tests__/form-entitlements.test.ts --rootDir . --outDir /tmp/sf-form-entitlements --module commonjs --target es2020 --moduleResolution node --esModuleInterop --skipLibCheck && NODE_PATH=./node_modules node /tmp/sf-form-entitlements/server/src/utils/__tests__/form-entitlements.test.js
scripts.test:unit:telegram-security: rm -rf /tmp/sf-telegram-security && tsc server/src/ee/telegram/__tests__/security.test.ts --rootDir . --outDir /tmp/sf-telegram-security --module commonjs --target es2020 --moduleResolution node --esModuleInterop --skipLibCheck && NODE_PATH=./node_modules node /tmp/sf-telegram-security/server/src/ee/telegram/__tests__/security.test.js
scripts.test:unit:telegram-server: rm -rf /tmp/sf-telegram-server && tsc server/src/ee/telegram/__tests__/*.test.ts server/src/services/__tests__/telegram.test.ts server/src/controllers/__tests__/telegram.test.ts --rootDir . --outDir /tmp/sf-telegram-server --module commonjs --target es2020 --moduleResolution node --esModuleInterop --resolveJsonModule --skipLibCheck && cp package.json /tmp/sf-telegram-server/package.json && NODE_PATH=./node_modules node --test /tmp/sf-telegram-server/server/src/ee/telegram/__tests__/*.test.js /tmp/sf-telegram-server/server/src/services/__tests__/telegram.test.js /tmp/sf-telegram-server/server/src/controllers/__tests__/telegram.test.js
scripts.test:unit:telegram-admin: rm -rf /tmp/sf-telegram-admin && tsc admin/src/ee/__tests__/telegram-connections.test.ts admin/src/ee/__tests__/telegram-notification-settings.test.ts admin/src/ee/__tests__/telegram-template-document.test.ts --rootDir . --outDir /tmp/sf-telegram-admin --module commonjs --target es2020 --moduleResolution node --esModuleInterop --skipLibCheck && node --test /tmp/sf-telegram-admin/admin/src/ee/__tests__/telegram-connections.test.js /tmp/sf-telegram-admin/admin/src/ee/__tests__/telegram-notification-settings.test.js /tmp/sf-telegram-admin/admin/src/ee/__tests__/telegram-template-document.test.js
scripts.test:unit:telegram: npm run test:unit:telegram-server && npm run test:unit:telegram-admin && npm run test:unit:telegram-lexical
scripts.test:unit:telemetry: tsc server/src/services/__tests__/telemetry.test.ts --rootDir . --outDir /tmp/sf-test-out --module commonjs --target es2020 --moduleResolution node --esModuleInterop --resolveJsonModule --skipLibCheck && cp package.json /tmp/sf-test-out/package.json && node /tmp/sf-test-out/server/src/services/__tests__/telemetry.test.js
scripts.test:unit:entitlement: npm run test:unit:license-lifecycle && npm run test:unit:premium-jobs && npm run test:unit:admin-license && npm run test:unit:conditional-relations && npm run test:unit:conditional-config && npm run test:unit:form-entitlements && npm run test:unit:conditional-submission && npm run test:unit:public-analytics && npm run test:unit:conditional-logic-view && npm run test:unit:premium-surfaces && npm run test:unit:premium-removal && npm run test:unit:payment-required && npm run test:unit:form-api-error && npm run test:unit:release-workflow && npm run test:unit:telegram
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run build && npm run verify
